title: xdrip showing 212 and up while real bg was 54
symptom: xDrip showed BG values of 212 and above while a fingerstick measurement was 54, indicating a dangerous discrepancy. The issue occurred after an old sensor stopped functioning and was replaced without stopping/restarting the sensor in xDrip.
cause: The thread identifies that the sensor was replaced without stopping/restarting it in xDrip, leading to invalid calibration data with extreme intercept values (e.g., 123) that caused incorrect BG calculations.
fix: The thread suggests implementing checks to reject bad calibration data (e.g., intercept > 30 or 40) and to detect when a new sensor is started. The issue was resolved by PR #887.
evidence_quote: I have created https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/pull/638 as a proof of concept of what I things that should be done.
